title: Special Education Needs? (S.E.N)
description: Created as part of the series ‘Present Tense’, this short is a spoken word/documentary hybrid, that poetically reflects on personal experiences of the British education system. Debris Stevenson returns to her school memories, relating her feelings as someone with dyslexia, and the frustration of being labelled a failure.
sound: Matthew Edwards Charlie Leeds (aka Mark Valentine) has become a bit of a legend in the outdoor world. Famously a modern-day hard man
working as a bouncer on the streets of Leeds
his cover was blown when visitors to his bar found him reading “The Nature of Snowdonia” on the door.
